question.text: Total number of ways of selecting 2 white squares on a normal chess board if the squares are not from the same row or column is equal to

solution.text: 2 white squares can be selected in ${ }^{32} \mathrm{C}_{2}$ ways If they belong to some row or same column then $2\left(8 \cdot{ }^{4} \mathrm{C}_{2}\right)$ ways.
